newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 4.275 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 4.275 mln gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended Oct 12 was 4,275,039 gallons compared with 4,004,866 gallons last week.
Imports were 308,002 gallons compared with 708,457 gallons the previous week, and domestic receipts totaled 167,699 gallons versus 59,613 gallons a week ago.
Retail movement was 869,667 gallons compared with 1,049,934 gallons last year, while bulk movement was 3,162,015 gallons versus 3,934,363 gallons last year.
Current season cumulative movement was 241,262,598 versus 237,194,617 a year ago.
Inventory was 56,704,907 versus 71,589,881 gallons last year.
The final total pack for the season is 202,353,371 gallons compared with 216,502,392 gallons a year ago.
